title: Anthropic’s 4,000 TOPS AI chip may use Samsung 2nm tech
key_facts: Anthropic is reportedly considering Samsung's 2nm process for a custom AI accelerator.
Sources are SemiconductorsX and Jukan; no company confirmation.
quote_evidence: Anthropic's reportedly considering Samsung's 2nm process for a custom AI accelerator that could deliver up to 4,000 TOPS.
According to information shared by SemiconductorsX and Jukan, Anthropic's custom AI ASIC is being developed with Broadcom as its design partner.
Initial production is reportedly expected to reach around 200,000 chips.
why_it_matters_hint: AI labs may design own chips.
